summary: Adaptive navigation moved before trainer gate rejection
symptom: A cave warp approach moved Route 106 from x66,y19 to x63,y16 before a later chunk hit the damaged-party trainer gate

unexpected.predicted: A denied adaptive route performs no movement and leaves the live position unchanged
unexpected.actual: The route executed earlier chunks before trainer_engagement_blocked was raised

authority.oracle: RunBunAdapter canonical RAM observation and adaptive-route regression test

steps: deny the complete route in the trainer gate
reproduction.observed: Both runs denied before any movement call.

root_cause.claim: follow_live_path_adaptive checked trainer readiness only inside follow_route chunks, allowing earlier chunks to mutate the live position before a later denial.
evidence: The live failure moved x66,y19 to x63,y16 before denial.
The fixed regression rejects the full planned path before follow_route.
alternatives_falsified: The restored checkpoint returned the exact pre-probe map and canonical state hash.

solution.contract_change: Adaptive navigation must preflight the entire planned route before issuing the first movement chunk.
solution.workaround: Restore auto-forward-latest.state after any pre-fix partial route rejection.

replay.expected: A denied route makes no movement call.
replay.actual: Both replay runs denied before follow_route.

domain_knowledge: Trainer-gated movement must be atomic with respect to the planned route.
regression_cases: A denied adaptive route must issue zero movement inputs.
tooling_contracts: follow_live_path_adaptive performs whole-route trainer preflight before chunk execution.
